items.title: AI Symptom Checker
items.focused_finding: Urgency and possible-condition output must remain an unvalidated candidate; symptom-to-diagnosis or emergency disposition requires qualified controls.

items.title: AI Emergency Detection
items.focused_finding: Automatic emergency activation and notification claims do not establish reliable detection, connectivity or recipient authorization.

items.title: Blood Group Module
items.focused_finding: Always Visible conflicts with permission boundaries; retain the original requirement but require scoped emergency disclosure and verified blood-group provenance.

items.title: Organ Donor Module
items.focused_finding: Donor status display is not jurisdictional consent or transplant eligibility; preserve restrictions and provenance.

items.title: Men's Health Quality of Life Assessment
Quality of Life Assessment for Women
Global Healthcare Artificial Superintelligence Core
items.focused_finding: Supreme intelligence is aspirational source wording. Coordination cannot absorb subsystem accountability or grant unrestricted autonomy.

items.title: European Digital Health Technologies Intelligence Ecosystem
items.focused_finding: Foundation Architecture Complete is a source assertion, not verified readiness. Preserve separate patient, clinician, research and governance responsibilities.

items.title: Clinical Emergency Medicine Platform Core Engine
Clinical Intensive Care Platform Core Engine
Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis Disease Activity Module
Vaccination Smart Notification Engine
items.focused_finding: Delivery owns notifications; determining due, overdue or catch-up status depends on separately versioned immunization rules and patient context.

items.title: Vaccine Allergy Registry
items.focused_finding: Preserve suspected versus confirmed reaction, product, batch, dose, timing and specialist attribution; do not convert uncertainty to absence.

items.title: Vaccine Component Allergy Cross-Check Engine
items.focused_finding: Ingredient, excipient, residual and packaging evidence remain distinct; a potential conflict requests review and must not automatically refuse vaccination.

items.title: Privacy-Preserving Vaccine Exemption Verification Module
items.focused_finding: Verify a scoped exemption claim with issuer and expiry while withholding diagnosis; token verification must not imply clinical validity or legal acceptance.

items.title: Vaccine Certificate QR Verification Module
items.focused_finding: Certificate and issuer verification do not authorize access to underlying records; preserve separate authorization and expiry checks.

items.title: Vaccination Evidence Provenance Engine
items.focused_finding: Rule evidence must retain authority, document, version, dates, jurisdiction and supersession; unsupported generated rules cannot enter production logic.

items.title: Vaccination AI Decision Support Module
items.focused_finding: Preserve clinician-facing scope and the explicit prohibition on autonomous exemption or contraindication certification.

items.title: Retinopathy of Prematurity Screening & Treatment Module
items.focused_finding: Retain gestational/birth-weight context, stage/zone and treatment pathways. Share a prospective ophthalmic profile with 4965 only after retaining both source bodies and distinct follow-up requirements.

items.title: Adolescent Menstrual Health & Digital Cycle Record Module
items.focused_finding: Cycle recording is optional; age-aware confidential access cannot be replaced by blanket guardian visibility.

items.title: Adolescent Abnormal Uterine Bleeding & Menorrhagia Module
items.focused_finding: Bleeding, anemia and hemodynamic escalation requirements need qualified review; no threshold or treatment rule is supplied by this review.

items.title: Adolescent Dysmenorrhea & Menstrual Pain Management Module
items.focused_finding: Preserve school/activity impact and secondary-cause assessment, not only pain intensity.

items.title: Adolescent Endometriosis & Chronic Pelvic Pain Module
items.focused_finding: Retain suspected and confirmed disease separately and the explicit principle that symptom burden remains visible despite limited objective findings.

items.title: Adolescent Polycystic Ovary & Hyperandrogenism Clinical Module
items.focused_finding: Preserve adolescent-specific developmental and diagnostic safeguards against premature classification.

items.title: Retinopathy of Prematurity Screening & Longitudinal Care Module
items.focused_finding: Overlap candidate with 4734; retain oxygen/respiratory context, post-treatment surveillance, refractive outcome and due/overdue follow-up rather than collapsing by title.
